text:
Anya: BlueHarbor (prospect) returned their security questionnaire. They want SIEM ingest proof (offline OK), tenant KMS rotation history (last 2 rotations), RBAC tamper-evidence, and a short vuln-triage/IR note. Need an evidence bundle by EOD.

Oren: I can assemble exports. They accept NDJSON + signed manifest for now? Also confirm PII redaction expectations.

Anya: NDJSON + signed manifest is fine to start. Include redaction rules and a 2-line before/after sample. They want chain proof for RBAC events.

Leah: Plan:
- redacted NDJSON audit export for tenant (date window requested)
- manifest.json (files, sha256 checksums, signer id, kms_envelope_key_id, rotation_history)
- detached signature manifest.sig (platform signer)
- RBAC chain anchors (daily root hashes + signature)
- sanitized KMS describe-key output showing last two rotations
- short vuln-triage note + IR playbook reference

Samir: Example extraction query (postgres):
```sql
SELECT sequence_id, actor, action, target, metadata->>'req_id' AS req, created_at
FROM audit_events
WHERE tenant_id='blueharbor' AND created_at >= '2026-02-01'
ORDER BY sequence_id ASC;
```

Samir: We'll run audit-redact v3 (user.email -> hash, redact ssn) then produce NDJSON and manifest. For hosted customers manifest includes KMS envelope key arn.

Priya: RBAC immutability: events are append-only. We compute a daily chained anchor (sha256 of batch roots) and sign anchors with redwood-platform-signer-v2. Include anchors for requested window and a README with recompute steps.

Leah: KMS example (sanitized) to include:
{"KeyId":"projects/REDACTED/locations/global/keyRings/envelope/cryptoKeys/ENVEL-7777","RotationHistory":["2025-11-12T10:00:00Z","2026-03-08T16:22:00Z"]}

Samir: Verification snippet for the bundle:
```bash
curl -O https://s3.redwood-internal/blueharbor/audit_blueharbor_2026-04-12.ndjson
curl -O https://s3.redwood-internal/blueharbor/manifest.json
curl -O https://s3.redwood-internal/blueharbor/manifest.sig
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature manifest.sig manifest.json
sha256sum -c <<< "<sha256sum>  audit_blueharbor_2026-04-12.ndjson"
```

Priya: Vulnerability triage note: reference runtime patch v3.4.2 deployed 2026-03-28 that mitigates CVE-2026-xxxx; list outstanding low-risk findings and mitigation timeline. Attach incident_response_playbook_v2.md and contact for SOC drills.

audit-bot: Ticket SEC-2124 created: "BlueHarbor SQ evidence bundle" assigned to @Leah @Samir @Priya.

Leah: I'll stage artifacts to /private/blueharbor-evidence/ and paste internal links here when uploaded.

Samir: Uploaded (internal links):
- https://s3.redwood-internal/blueharbor/audit_blueharbor_2026-04-12.ndjson
- https://s3.redwood-internal/blueharbor/manifest.json
- https://s3.redwood-internal/blueharbor/manifest.sig
- https://s3.redwood-internal/blueharbor/rbac_anchors_2026-04-12.txt
- https://s3.redwood-internal/blueharbor/redaction_rules_v3.md
- https://s3.redwood-internal/blueharbor/redaction_sample_before_after.txt
- https://s3.redwood-internal/blueharbor/kms_describe_envelope_2026-04-12.json (sanitized)
- https://s3.redwood-internal/blueharbor/incident_response_playbook_v2.md

Anya: Great. I'll assemble the SQ crosswalk mapping each questionnaire item to artifacts and send initial packet to their security team. If they request live SIEM HEC demo we'll schedule a scrubbed demo next week.

Leah: Noted — if they request full forensic WAL exports we require NDA and IR coordination. I'll add that caveat to the crosswalk.

Anya: Thanks team, keep any follow-ups in this thread. :white_check_mark:
